description: This file defines a React functional component named `Login` that renders a login form with email, password, and organization ID inputs. It manages authentication state, handles form submission by calling an external API, and redirects upon successful login. The component uses React hooks such as useState, useNavigate, and useLocation.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React functional component rendering the login form, handling input changes, form submission, and redirection.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the form state when user types in input fields.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls authentication API, manages loading/error states, and navigates on success.
